**Two forms drawn on one page, `render_wp_config.py` test missing `--table-prefix`, patch release recipe — 22/10/2026, in-place patch, NO PR upstream yet** (S-50, S-51, S-52; branch `feat/wp-contact-mail-tool-fixes`). S-50 `scripts/lib/form-embed.mjs`: `readForm` read every control of a section as ONE form, so a page drawing two forms (a quote card and a support card) became one Contact Form 7 form merging the fields of both, and `embedShortcode` replaced both cards and everything between them with one shortcode (measured on a fixture: the titles of both cards and the line between them disappeared). Now `sourceForms` splits the controls into separate forms (a field that comes after a submit button opens a new form — a button with no `type` or `type="submit"`, and also `type="button"` because design exports often draw submit buttons that way, except a button sitting next to a field in the same parent element, like a "show password" button; a reset button stays with its form; controls inside a different `<form>` are split too; a lone button before the first field goes with the next form), `sourceForm` returns the FIRST form, `embedShortcode` embeds only the first form and returns `left` (buttons + field labels) for the remaining forms — the seeder builds exactly one CF7 form per locale, so a second shortcode would print the first form's fields inside the second form's card. `scripts/seed.mjs` writes, for each remaining form, a note `form: 'contact'` stating that the form is not embedded and sends nothing. Test: `scripts/test/form-embed.test.mjs` (two-form fixture). S-51 `scripts/test/quickstart.test.mjs`: the fleet's `render_wp_config.py` has required `--table-prefix` since b63edef9ce (23/09), the test called it without it and went red; it now passes `tr_` (the prefix the shipped config declares, byte-identical), and adds an empty case (keeps the file's literal) and a `site7_` case (overwrites exactly that line, the rest unchanged). S-52 `references/quickstart.md` §Patch release recipe: restore the previous release (`restore.mjs --pack <previous release folder>`) → baseline sweep with the previous zip → `patch-chain.mjs --baseline …`; and the `--no-baseline "<reason>"` path runs each phase separately (`cycle.mjs --to verify` → `site-sweep.mjs` without `--baseline` → `port-audit.mjs` → `cycle.mjs --from contract-bind --no-baseline`), because `patch-chain.mjs` always gives the sweep `--baseline` while still passing `--no-baseline` to release → `measure-baseline-conflict` (read from the code, not yet run on a stand).

**Road to live gates (TCQR/TDSR/slots) run early, without waiting for the release step — 22/10/2026, in-place patch, NO PR upstream yet** (JA Diner 8.0 h: TCQR ABOUT-1/2/3 must-fix, TDSR SLOT-1 `ready:false`, 37 built-site/preview rules unmeasured because the machine lacked the `tracy/web-wordpress` image; JA Restaurant was released with slot `ready:false` and preview rules unmeasured, /ops reported `ds-not-at-probe`). Added `scripts/quickstart/road-precheck.mjs`: `--prereq [--build]` checks (and builds with `DEFAULTS_ONLY=1 bash web/build.sh wordpress`) the image that the TracyHQ repo's `stand.mjs` runs; `--theme-zip … --slug … [--pack] --stage pilot` builds a temporary release folder (theme zip, webroot, database, `tracy_setting.json`, `design-system-roles.json` from `role-scan.mjs`) then runs TCQR + TDSR; `--release <dir> --tag <tag> --stage release` checks an existing folder. Classification follows the repo's `rule-severity.json` (a rule not listed = must-fix): blocker / worth-fixing / pending; at pilot, `unmeasured` rules and a not-yet-built `tracy_site_pages.json` are pending, a missing slot contract is a blocker, a `ready:false` draft is pending; at release, `unmeasured` preview rules and `ready:false` slots are blockers. Exit 0 / 1 (blocker present) / 2 (could not run). Docs: `SKILL.md` (Preflight line, pilot gate adds a fifth check, Phase 10 gate), `references/measurement-protocol.md` §3 (fifth check), `references/quickstart.md` §Road to live, `references/tools.md`. `--version` is required when building the temporary folder (no 1.0.0 default); `--pack` takes only the archive of exactly that version (a pack reused across versions that lacks the right one is an error, listing what the pack has); `--setting-template` keeps the fields of the released version but rewrites the version, archive name and sha256; a missing `tracy_site_pages.json` is only pending at pilot, at release REL-2 blocks. Test: `scripts/test/road-precheck.test.mjs`. The next `git subtree pull` will overwrite these files: get the change upstream before that pull.

**Widget marks behind a translucent tile and links around a form when stacked — 21/10/2026, in-place patch, NO PR upstream yet** (JA Fresco S-35, S-36, re-measured on the port stand). `visual/site-sweep-behaviour.mjs` (S-35): `throughTile` fits `on = a·off + b` per channel over the fixed widget's box; when its tile is translucent (0.1 < a < 0.9, e.g. a `rgba(0,0,0,.5)` background) the "mark" is the pixels that deviate from the fit, not the page behind showing through — previously a 50×50 back-to-top button sitting over a spot where the page changes from dark to light was read as mark 50×29 ↔ 32×26 (the real arrow is 14×9), also in the "transparent" branch when a dark tile on a dark page deviated by less than 12. `visual/site-sweep-behaviour-probe.mjs` (S-36): `formsInPage` takes the whole list (a `ul`/`ol` that does not contain the form itself) when one of its links is within 60 px of the form — on narrow screens the links stack and the last link falls out of range on the side that draws one extra line, which was reported as `form-links-only-*` although both sides have it; a list that starts further away is still not part of the form area. Tests (each case red on the old tool): `scripts/test/site-sweep-behaviour.test.mjs`. The next `git subtree pull` will overwrite these files: get the change upstream before that pull.

**http-parity queries, post owners during prune, paths in the sweep dossier and input button capitalisation — 21/10/2026, in-place patch, NO PR upstream yet** (JA Fresco S-31..S-34; S-17 — visual-qa exit 1 on a report with no finding because of 9 `notMeasured` interaction states on `/404` — was closed by JA Restaurant's S-31 patch in the paragraph below, re-measured on the restored stand: exit 0, `interaction: run, notMeasured 0, examined 9`). `http-parity.mjs` (S-31): when `--routes` is a page-map, a `rules` pair whose target carries a query (a search page read with a keyword) is the pair of the page-map path without the query (an exact match still wins), and `--pages` names that path with or without the query — previously the route was read as `/find` without the query. `quickstart/lib.mjs` (S-32): the owners query (`ownersPhp`) adds an `owns` column = the number of published/private/scheduled posts that user wrote + the number of attachments in its user meta (`tracy_avatar` or keys matching `USERMETA_KEY_PATTERN` of `prune-usermeta.mjs`); `classifyPrune` keeps (KEEP) a user the seeder has not marked but who still owns kept content, and `staleRemoval` refuses to delete when the re-read sees `owns > 0` — the five authors of Fresco's author grid, seeded without meta, were once pruned and lost their avatars. `visual/site-sweep-scope.mjs` + `visual/site-sweep.mjs` (S-33): the `out` of a run and of `measured`, and `history` in `summary.json`/`site-sweep.json` are written relative to the dossier (`dossierPath`), `dossier.runRoot` records the path inside the checkout that holds the dossier (`dossierName`) — no more machine paths in files that go into the repo; files outside the dossier keep their path. `visual/site-sweep-behaviour-judge.mjs` (S-34): `label-case` compares label text as drawn (`shownLabel`: applies the computed `text-transform` to the text), because the `innerText` of a `<button>` has already been transformed while the `value` of an `<input type=submit>` has not — previously both sides in upper case still reported `label-case|button|uppercase>uppercase`. Tests (each case red on the old tool): `scripts/test/http-parity-pages.test.mjs`, `scripts/test/issue33.test.mjs`, `scripts/test/site-sweep-history.test.mjs`, `scripts/test/site-sweep-behaviour.test.mjs`; `scripts/test/site-sweep-scope.test.mjs` reads evidence via the dossier. The next `git subtree pull` will overwrite these files: get the change upstream before that pull.

**Forms submitted by script and pages that scroll themselves on load — 21/10/2026, in-place patch, NO PR upstream yet** (JA Restaurant S-41, S-42, re-measured on the restored stand). `visual/interaction-page.mjs` `scriptSubmit`: a `type="button"` button whose `onclick` submits ITS OWN form (`this.form.submit()`, `document.<name|id>.submit()`, `document.forms['<name>'].submit()`) is that form's submit button, even when its label is just an icon + `title` (Joomla's com_tags filter form: "source: no submit control found" on `/explore/j-pages/tagged-items`, one unmeasurable state made the whole four-tier checkpoint `incomplete`); a button that submits a different form is not. `visual/interaction-parity.mjs`: the guard records which write request is a main-frame navigation (`nav`); a click with no submit event whose only write request is a main-frame navigation, with the form's method, to the form's address (`form.submit()` POST) is read as `fired: true, lifecycle: navigation` — the same evidence already accepted for a GET form going through the navigation guard. `visual/site-sweep.mjs` `load`: a page that scrolls itself on load (an `autofocus` field below the first screen: the source's login form) is scrolled back to the top before the probe reads, because every box is read in viewport coordinates — the source header was once measured at −411 px (`header-height|Δ630/620/578` on `/your-profile`, `/explore/j-pages/login`, `/explore/j-pages/user-profile`). `visual/site-sweep-accept.mjs` `applyAccept` (S-43): a `sweep.accept` line for `heights` is judged against the widths heights actually read (`scope.heightsWidths`, passed in by `site-sweep.mjs`), not against the sweep's widths — previously a line naming only 576 or 992 was silently ignored, neither an error nor a match. Tests: `scripts/test/interaction-pairing.test.mjs` (Joomla filter form; button submitting another form), `scripts/test/site-sweep.test.mjs` (autofocus page), `scripts/test/site-sweep-heights.test.mjs` (heights line at 576). The next `git subtree pull` will overwrite these files: get the change upstream before that pull.

**States unmeasurable because the source has nothing to measure — 21/10/2026, in-place patch, NO PR upstream yet** (JA Restaurant S-31, S-32, S-40; S-29 and S-30 closed in the patch above, re-measured on the saved HTML of the source and the port). A source whose page-map declares `theme.darkDerived: true` and has no dark toggle: `visual/contract.mjs init` writes `source.darkDerived: true` (validate rejects any value other than `true`, or one combined with `darkHook`/`darkRequestHook`); `visual/group-verdict.mjs` does not demand `menus` on the dark axis with the reason "the source export has no dark of its own" when the contract declares so, and lists them in `notOwed`; `visual/site-sweep.mjs` (+ `-behaviour`, `-heights`, `-judge` `darkPassGap`, `-summary`) writes dark cells into `notOwed` instead of `owed`, and a dark cell of the behaviour checks only owes `fixed-widgets` (the other three checks read in the first scheme); `quickstart/release.mjs` accepts that `notOwed` only when the release's visual contract declares `source.darkDerived`, and writes the cell count on the receipt. The declaration stands only on a contract that is fresh against the spec-pack being read and whose page-map still declares `theme.darkDerived` (`lib/canonical.mjs` `darkDerivedProblems`, using `identityOf` like `release.mjs`; sweep, group-verdict, visual-qa and release all read it); a dark cell is closed only when the sweep had a light pass, a sweep that read no cell (`measuredCells: 0`) does not exit 0, and release refuses a sweep that measured no behaviour cell. Without the declaration it is still owed as before. `visual/visual-qa.mjs` `megaNotOwed` + `visual/menu-open.mjs` `headerCensus`: a mega walk reporting `NO ITEMS` on a page whose contract declares an error state, where the source has no header and neither side has a menu trigger (census measured), is not owed, and writes `notOwed` + `evidence` (S-31, the T3 source's 404 page). Docs: `references/visual-qa.md`, `references/tools.md`. `scripts/lib/canonical.mjs`. Tests: `scripts/test/{group-verdict,visual-contract,site-sweep-behaviour,quickstart-release,visual-qa}.test.mjs`, `scripts/test/quickstart-contracts.mjs`. ## Dump of a running Joomla site — 15/09/2026

`1.3.0`, `039359b`. `scripts/ingest/joomla-dump.mjs`: six tables from the site's database → `inventory.json`
+ `render-routes.json`, i.e. the two files `from-joomla.mjs` requires. Read-only, every column `CAST AS CHAR`, each row
one JSON built by the database itself (Joomla article bodies contain newlines/tabs that a TSV dump loses while **looking like
success**). The password is read from the compose `.env`.

Measured on Tracy Base revived from `quickstart-builds/tracy-base-cleanup`: 82 articles · 19 categories ·
102 menus · 116 modules · **43 routes** — exactly the original build run whose folder had disappeared. The generated contract
**matches the one that went through the bridge**: 20 types · 129 records · 3 menus, article bodies identical word for word.

⚠ It **does not build `capture/`**: enough to get the content model, not enough to get the design (ACM schema falls back to
heuristics, palette/layout from the template CSS is skipped).

It also exposed a real defect: `site-model.mjs` read routes from the raw path in the DB, while the menu carries renamed
names (D2 renamed three `mag-*` categories) — every renamed item looked like it pointed to a route that does not exist. Now
routes follow **the page as resolved by the adapter**, pinned by a test.

## Neutral source contract — 15/09/2026

`1.2.0`, `f99a8c9`. `scripts/ingest/from-joomla.mjs` emits **an additional** `site-model.json` next to the spec-pack
(TCH's ADR 0016): it describes the source in a vocabulary that belongs to no CMS, built from **Joomla article HTML as the
author wrote it** — before `html-to-blocks` — so it carries no WordPress trace. Logic in
`scripts/ingest/site-model.mjs`; 5 new tests. **Nothing in this kit reads it yet**: `seed.mjs` still reads the four
old files, and that is deliberate — adding a file before anyone depends on it breaks nothing.

🔒 **The `tracy-site-model/v1` string is DECLARED, not imported.** Three skills in three repos, none of which may
depend on another (ADR 0006). So each side declares the version of the contract it speaks, and **TCH — the only tree that
vendors all three — keeps the gate proving they still match**: `scripts/check-site-model.ts` runs this adapter's output
through the EmDash kit's validator and compiler. Changing that string means changing the gate in the same pass.

## Why it is vendored rather than in `.agents/skills/`

This skill was born in TCH (branch `feat/tracy-base-wp7`, 13–14/09/2026) and then **moved out** —
the same path `vendor/joomla/joomlart-t4-skill` took, for the same three reasons:

1. **It does not serve only TCH.** It builds WordPress sites for customers, so it is a JoomlArt-Products
   product next to the Joomla skill, not an internal tool of this repo.
2. **It has its own life cycle.** 452 tests, its own `npm install` (playwright + jsdom), its own version
   number. `.agents/skills/` is the place for skills **about this repo itself** (`run-dev`, `tch-dev`,
   `pr-merge`, `tracy-emdash-template`).
3. **One source of truth.** Keeping it in both places means two copies, and the second drifts silently.

In exchange, it is **no longer a slash command** in a TCH session — `.claude/skills/` only mirrors
`.agents/skills/`. Use it one of two ways, exactly like the Joomla skill:

- **Read in place**: `vendor/wordpress/tracy-wordpress-theme/skills/tracy-wordpress-theme/SKILL.md`
  is the router; it names which packet to read for each phase.
- **Install as a plugin** (outside TCH): `/plugin marketplace add JoomlArt-Products/tracy-wordpress-theme`
  then `/plugin install tracy-wordpress-theme@tracy-wordpress`. See `INSTALL.md` at the root of this tree.

## Private repo — and do not change that

`skills/*/references/*.md` are written in **Vietnamese**, per TCH's rule for internal docs. The "public
surfaces are English" rule of `CLAUDE.md` means this tree may only be made public after translating every
reference into English. The sibling repo `JoomlArt-Products/tracy-joomla-template` is private too
(for a different reason: it bundles JoomlArt's commercial software).

This tree does **not** bundle any commercial software — see `NOTICE.md`. It weighs 2.5 MB, no blobs — the only two
binary files are test fixtures (`hero.png`, `deck.pdf`, a few KB).

## Upgrading

Fix upstream and then pull, do not fix in place (RULE #5):

```
git subtree pull --prefix vendor/wordpress/tracy-wordpress-theme \
  git@github.com:JoomlArt-Products/tracy-wordpress-theme.git main --squash
```

An urgent patch made directly in this tree must be pushed back upstream the same day, and
this `IMPORT-NOTE` must record the new commit — otherwise the next `pull` will delete it.

## Things it refers to that live outside this tree

- The theme it builds: `packages/cms/tracy-wordpress-theme` (build targets `tracy` and `tracy-base`) — **Tracy's
  code**, not vendor.
- The dossier of the first build run: `tasks/tracy-base-wp7/` (spec-pack, decisions D1–D17, gaps G1–G21,
  report). The skill keeps summary measurements in `examples/tracy-base-wp7.md`; the full dossier is in TCH.
- The quickstart it captures: release `tracy-base/wp7` on `JoomlArt-Products/ja-products`, pinned in
  `packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/scripts/provision/quickstarts.json`.
- One test skips itself outside TCH: `the fleet render_wp_config.py accepts the shipped wp-config.php
  shape` needs the fleet's `scripts/provision/render_wp_config.py`. In this tree it runs — `npm test` on pin
  `520e670` gives **486/486, 0 skip** (measured 15/09/2026, 92 s); in the standalone repo it skips. That is
  intended, not broken.
  ⚠ The first pin (`88498b73c3ed`) located the script with a relative path counting folders, so it **skipped
  even inside TCH** after moving into vendor — a real check silently turned into a skip. Fixed upstream
  (`b5a4e26089d3`) and then `git subtree pull` the same day, exactly the loop described below; that was also the
  first trial run of that loop.
